verdict.rationale: Vapi's docs clearly describe OpenAI-style function/tool calling triggered mid-call via webhooks, with the assistant able to transfer calls, look up records, book appointments, or end calls based on tool results (vapi-docs-23, vapi-docs-17, vapi-docs-38, vapi-docs-6, vapi-docs-34, vapi-docs-20). Latency-related configuration (model intelligence vs speed tradeoffs) is documented, but there's no explicit first-party or community evidence of a specific 'filler phrase while waiting' mechanism to eliminate dead air during tool execution. missing for 10: explicit documentation of anti-dead-air filler/hold speech during tool calls, independent hands-on confirmation of smooth mid-call function-call speech.
